Title: Microstate pKa values
Description: Predicts the microstate pKa that decides which ionisation state a molecule adopts at physiological pH, and with it solubility, permeability and binding. Mayr and colleagues paired a graph neural network with Dimorphite-DL to enumerate protonation states. Bundled here is pkasolver-light, the ensemble trained only on the 5994 experimental values so it can ship without an Epik licence, and its applicability is limited to monoprotic molecules. Only the first microstate is returned, with the spread across the ensemble.
Interpretation: First predicted microstate pKa of the molecule in pKa units, with the standard deviation across the model ensemble.
